title: Company Overview
text: Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions. The company provides equipment, services, and software used to manufacture semiconductor chips and advanced displays. Its technologies support the electronics industry and the development of next-generation chips.

title: Applied Materials India Overview
text: Applied Materials India has been part of the company's global innovation network for more than two decades. Teams in India contribute to research and development, product engineering, software engineering, design, validation, and end-to-end product lifecycle development.

title: Applied Materials India Locations
text: Applied Materials India was founded in 2002. Its India headquarters is in Bengaluru. The company lists its India presence in Bengaluru, Chennai, Mumbai, and Pune.

title: India Validation Center
text: The India Validation Center is a major milestone in India's semiconductor journey. Applied Materials describes it as India's first and only 300 mm semiconductor research and development facility.

title: India Engineering Capabilities
text: Applied Materials India provides product design, engineering services, support, and software development to the global organization. Its engineering activities support product development through design, simulation, testing, and validation.

title: Semiconductor Manufacturing
text: Applied Materials supplies tools and solutions used by semiconductor manufacturers to produce chips. Its materials engineering technologies support processes that deposit materials on wafers, modify material properties, shape materials, remove materials, and measure semiconductor structures.

title: Company Headquarters
text: The global headquarters of Applied Materials is in Santa Clara, California, USA. The India headquarters is in Bengaluru, India.

title: Careers at Applied Materials
text: Applied Materials offers career paths including application engineering, process engineering, global supply chain, product development engineering, field service engineering, and software development. Candidates can explore open positions and apply online through the company's careers website.

title: Job Applications
text: Candidates can search for jobs based on location, job category, and keywords. Applicants should prepare an electronic copy of their resume before submitting an online application. Candidates should apply separately to each position they wish to pursue.

title: Internships
text: Applied Materials may offer paid internships in certain regions in areas such as engineering, finance, marketing, and other functions. Availability depends on the region and current opportunities.
